arg.name: image
arg.description: The image topic. Should be remapped to the name of the real image topic.

arg.name: use_camera_info
arg.description: Indicates that the camera_info topic should be subscribed to to get the default input_frame_id. Otherwise the frame from the image message will be used.

arg.name: debug_view
arg.description: Specify whether the node displays a window to show image

arg.name: queue_size
arg.description: Specigy queue_size of input image subscribers

arg.name: histogram_equalization_type
arg.description: Specify histogram equaliztion methods. 0: Default, 1: Clahe

arg.name: clahe_clip_limit
arg.description: The maximum allowed field value Clip Limit

arg.name: clahe_tile_size_x
arg.description: The maximum allowed field value Threshold X Limit

arg.name: clahe_tile_size_y
arg.description: The maximum allowed field value Threshold Y Limit
